title: Tasty Taco Tacos
description: A simple recipe for classic tacos with ground beef and a homemade taco seasoning. Serve with your favorite toppings.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works best

ingredients.name: Shredded Cheese
ingredients.notes: Cheddar or Monterey Jack work well

instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once browned, add the taco seasoning and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto a tortilla and topping with cheese, onions, and bell peppers.
Serve with salsa, cilantro, and lime juice on the side.
